title: T09c — Acceptance on an owner-selected Windows machine
goal: Acceptance on an owner-selected Windows machine.
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; actual profiles, backups, credentials and deployment evidence remain private.
acceptance: Acceptance on an owner-selected Windows machine
Implement validated install/status/start/stop/update/uninstall/recovery for supported Windows user services without changing unrelated tasks/installations
Preserve profile/source/root ownership, fencing, backups, interrupted operations and uncertain workers
Demonstrate selected Windows target lifecycle and reconnect, separating mocked fixtures from actual device evidence
validation: Meaningful cross-boundary regressions and required final CI
Explicit selected-target acceptance where service, install or real device behavior is required; static/unit passes do not substitute
escalation: Material acceptance/effort expansion or distinct outcome splitting requires owner agreement
Never change an unowned installation, service, engine or uncertain physical effect without explicit reconciliation

effort.basis: Owner-approved slice, 2026-11-11 (PR #264). Slice T09c of the step "Windows service lifecycle execution and target acceptance". Estimate, not a measurement. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 0.75 hours agent + 1 hour owner; agent prepares and records; the owner runs the acceptance on a Windows machine. Method: 1.5 h/day judged rate (PR #277). Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 0.5 kept as history. Re-estimated 2026-11-12 at 0.6x from `work-items calibrate` (median 0.55x over 6 closed steps; bug steps 0.6x over 5): 0.75 h → 0.5 h, min 0.5 h; owner hours and baseline kept. Estimate column backfilled 2026-11-12 at harness 7.0.0: estimateAgentHours = remaining plus actual so far (0.5 h); the baseline stays for calibration.
